name: matched-ks3-all-constant-spine-p01
hypothesis: Initialize both Hermite endpoint coefficients c0 and c1 to+0.1 in every dense/routed rank-one KS3 chart, leaving slopes and Chebyshev warp coefficients zero. Since the two endpoint basis functions sum to one, this yields the initial function ReLU(x+0.1)^2 rather than the zero-coefficient ReLU(x)^2, giving small negative projected features a gradient immediately. Test this constant activation shift as a separate architectural initialization hypothesis, distinct from earlier slope/warp/random priors and optimizer-memory changes. Restore geometry Adam betas[0.9,0.99] and retain multiplier0.125, width1024, rank one, BF16/GS32, projection policy, all45 feedforward branches, MoE8top1 and every shared/model-wide setting.
